summary: Iteration 11 — Integration Tarifs module (6 new routes + XSS DOMPurify fixes). Tested backend health + all 6 new frontend routes end-to-end. Backend GET /api/ still returns metiers=100 secteurs=12 (no regression). Frontend compiles cleanly. action_items: MINOR (spec vs implementation): The review request expected CTA hrefs like /contact-commercial?offre=X&type=etablissement (with a type param). Current implementation only passes ?offre=X (e.g. /contact-commercial?offre=entreprise-immersion). This is functionally correct because the ContactCommercial page derives the offre label from the offre key alone (OFFRES map already distinguishes 'etablissement-*' vs 'entreprise-*'), and the offre label is displayed & pre-selected as expected. Leave as-is unless the type param is required for future analytics/backend routing.
INFO: Form submissions (ContactCommercial + MoiDemainPlusSouscription) are still TODO/mock as expected — no backend endpoint exists yet.
critical_code_review_comments: ContactCommercial.jsx: no honeypot / rate limit yet — acceptable while it's still a TODO mock. When backend POST is wired, add server-side rate limiting.
MoiDemainPlusSouscription.jsx: uses browser alert() as placeholder — fine for demo; replace with proper toast + Stripe checkout redirect when integrating.
Minor: consider adding type=etablissement/entreprise in the CTA querystring to disambiguate future analytics, even if not strictly required today.
